new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/t"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.respond(
        template(HttpTemplate.TemplateType.VELOCITY)
                .withTemplate("{ \"statusCode\": 200 }")
                .withTemplateFile("some/file.vm")
                .withResponseOverride(
                        response()
                                .withStatusCode(201)
                                .withHeaders(
                                        new Header("x", "y")
                                )
                )
                .withResponseModifier(
                        responseModifier()
                                .withHeaders(
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("x-add", "1")
                                        ),
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("x-rep", "2", "3")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("x-rm","x-rm2")
                                )
                                .withCookies(
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("ca", "1")
                                        ),
                                        cookies(
                                                new Cookie("cr", "2")
                                        ),
                                        ImmutableList.of("cx")
                                )
                                .withCondition(
                                        responseModifierCondition()
                                                .withStatusCode(200)
                                                .withStatusCodeRange("2xx")
                                                .withResponseHasHeader("x-a")
                                                .withRequestHasHeader("x-b")
                                )
                                .withModifiers(Arrays.asList(
                                        responseModifier()
                                                .withHeaders(
                                                        headers(
                                                                new Header("inner", "v")
                                                        ),
                                                        null,
                                                        null
                                                ),
                                        responseModifier()
                                                .withJsonMergePatch("{\"a\":null,\"b\":\"c\\\"d\"}")
                                ))
                                .withJsonPatch("[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/a\",\"value\":\"b\\n\"}]")
                                .withJsonMergePatch("{\"x\":1}")
                )
);
